subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the open cross-repo Feishu candidate or start a fresh target-repository fix for this reply @mention bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the same-repository candidate is closed and the fork copy is conflicting with prior safety concerns around broad orphan placeholders and root routing.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the existing candidate as source context, but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and address the routing and mention-gating concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known bug without opening another repair lane until Feishu ownership bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing candidate as source context, but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the most recent merged work in Feishu mention handling and is the closest routing candidate for the safe detection shape.
